children: Cox Capital Partners on Wednesday announced two separate cash tender offers for class I shares of Blackstone's
Blackstone Private Credit Fund and BlackRock's

The private investment fund is offering to acquire BCRED shares at $20.65 per share, representing a 12.5% discount to NAV of $23.60 as of August 31. HLEND shares are offered to be acquired at $20.17 per share, representing a 17.5% discount to NAV of $24.45 as of July 31.
Cox Capital is initially offering to purchase up to $20M in aggregate value of class I shares of each fund for a total aggregate consideration of ~$40M.
The offers are scheduled to expire at 5:00 PM ET on November 3.

redemptions at 5.0% of shares outstanding as of June 30, or ~$600M, after receiving repurchase requests totaling ~11.5% of shares outstanding during Q3. Requests remained below ~13.3% seen in the second quarter.
repurchases at 5% of shares outstanding again after receiving repurchase requests for ~10% of its shares outstanding in Q3.

"Retail shareholders deserve access to the kinds of secondary liquidity options for their private-market exposure that institutional investors have enjoyed for years," said Cox Capital CEO John Cox. "These offers are intended to provide financial advisors and their clients with an additional liquidity option when a fund's own repurchase program cannot satisfy their full request."

title: Cox Capital launches tender offers for shares of Blackstone, BlackRock private credit funds at discount to NAV
